arcade.subtitle: Browser games designed by our teams, built with AI assistants, and controlled with hand gestures or the keyboard.

games.title: Star Catcher
games.story: Stars are falling from the night sky, and only you can catch them.
games.howto: The goal is simple: catch the gold stars and dodge the red rocks. First, move your basket left and right. Then, use your shield when the sky gets busy. To win, beat the best score before you lose three lives.
games.gestures: Left → move left · Right → move right · Shield → 2-second shield · Hands down → nothing (or ← → Space)
games.changed: After testing, we noticed that new players lost very fast, so we made the first ten seconds slower.

games.title: Approach & Survive (v4)
games.story: Approach & Survive is a colorful retro game inspired by Snake. Students must survive a school semester by collecting academic items and avoiding funny everyday problems.
games.howto: First, enter a nickname and start the game. Next, move your line of students to collect attendance, assignments, midterms, and finals to earn points. Then, avoid obstacles such as traffic, Wi-Fi problems, and distractions. Also, keep your attendance above 80% and avoid hitting walls or your own line. Finally, try to get the highest score and enter the Top 10 leaderboard.
games.gestures: Use the arrow keys or WASD to move. On tablets and smartphones, use the touch buttons on both sides of the screen. Press Pause to stop temporarily and Restart to play again.

games.title: Pong Challenge
games.story: Pong Challenge is a fun game where you can play against the computer or challenge a friend. The goal is to test your concentration, coordination, and reaction speed while having fun.
games.howto: First, choose between single-player mode and two-player mode. Next, move your paddle to hit the ball toward your opponent. Then, try to prevent the ball from passing your paddle. Each player starts with five lives and loses one when they lose a round. After winning against the computer, you advance to the next level, which becomes more difficult. Finally, complete all ten levels to win the game!
games.gestures: Player 1: Press W to move up and S to move down; Player 2: Press the Up Arrow (↑) to move up and the Down Arrow (↓) to move down; In single-player mode, the computer controls the second paddle.

games.title: Acorn Chase
games.story: You are a little squirrel in a colorful fall forest. Winter is coming, so you need to collect acorns while foxes run toward you.
games.howto: First, move along the forest path and collect acorns. Each acorn gives you one point. Next, jump over the foxes. If a fox touches you, you lose. Then, look for the golden leaf. When you pick it up, you run faster for five seconds. Finally, collect ten acorns to win the game.
games.gestures: Left arrow — move left. Right arrow — move right. Space bar — jump over foxes.

games.title: Star Catcher
games.team: Maria Dandara, Janaina Ferreira, Karolina Capela, & Luciene Coutinho
games.story: An astronaut collects falling stars in space while avoiding dangerous rocks. The goal is to collect 20 stars before losing all three lives.
games.howto: First, use the left and right arrow keys to move the astronaut. Next, catch falling stars to earn points. Then, press Space to activate a shield for two seconds when rocks get close. Finally, collect 20 stars to win, and watch out for rocks!
games.gestures: Left arrow → Move left. Right arrow → Move right. Space → Activate the shield for two seconds.
